text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Mortgage and Home Equity Rate Notice (version 2026-09, effective 2026-09-01), the HELOC introductory rate is 5.99% (APR 5.99%) for the first 12 months. The intro rate applies only to draws made during the introductory period. After that, the rate becomes variable at Prime (as published in The Wall Street Journal) plus 0.50%, with a maximum rate of 18.00%. Note the quoted rates assume an owner-occupied, single-family primary residence, loan-to-value of 80% or less and a credit score of 740+, and rates can change daily.","cited_chunk_ids":["mortgage_heloc_rate_notice::layout::B_structure::0000","mortgage_heloc_rate_notice::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The rate notice states the HELOC intro rate of 5.99% for the first 12 months and the post-intro variable rate."}
